mapper.select: SELECT d.id as dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.is_system, d.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_by, d.update_by, d.is_deleted, d.delete_time FROM sys_dept d INNER JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON d.id = ud.dept_id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.order_num ASC

SELECT d.id as dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.is_system, d.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_by, d.update_by, d.is_deleted, d.delete_time FROM sys_dept d INNER JOIN sys_role_dept rd ON d.id = rd.dept_id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND rd.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY d.order_num ASC

SELECT d.id as dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.is_system, d.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_by, d.update_by, d.is_deleted, d.delete_time FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 ORDER BY d.parent_id ASC, d.order_num ASC
